title: Finite exhaustive genuine W32 six-incidence original nine-cell forest universe census
statement: For h=1 only, genuine original W(3,2) has 45 distinct original incidences and binom(45,6)=8145060 actual six-incidence-ID subsets. Exhaustive source-only enumeration, independent of physical injections f,g, partitions the eligible A/B/C-on-both-sides sixsets into nine path cells of sizes A/A 1566360, A/B 1666980, B/A 1666980, A/C 6225, C/A 6225, B/C 5220, C/B 5220, B/B-overlap 910080, and B/B-disjoint 707580. These sum to 6540870 eligible source forest sixsets; 1604190 of the original 8145060 have source profiles outside the nine-cell A/B/C grid. The original A-side and B-side SOURCE totals are each 3648645, C-side 12285; these are not physical-half acceptance counts.

quantifiers.domain: integer h=1, s=2^h=2; finite genuine original W(3,2) ONLY, not all h
all binom(45,6)=8145060 six-DISTINCT actual original incidence-ID subsets of the finite W(3,2)

external_dependencies: Pinned original independent full W(3,2) 45 choose 6 source-only census from PR486; finite enumeration is a reproducible oracle, not a proof for h>1.
limitations: The complete finite source universe is NOT the 62370 physically admissible one-side candidates.
Some original sixsets have point or line source multiplicities outside A/B/C and are not any eligible nine source cells.
No finite source-only count certifies a uniform all-h positive physical GF5 minimax.
falsification_boundary: Must enumerate all distinct combinations of six of the true 45 original W(3,2) incident edges, not selected projected halves, synthetic graph patterns or random subsets.
